# Dropbox
> Discover Dropbox – secure, easy cloud storage for file sharing and collaboration. With Dash, save time and organize all your company content in one place.

- [Secure File Storage](https://dropbox.com/): Dropbox offers secure file storage, organization, and collaboration tools.

Migrate your files to Dropbox to keep them securely synced across devices.

- [Dropbox Ventures](https://www.dropbox.com/ventures):Dropbox Ventures is focused on investing in the next generation of startups who are driving the transition to an AI-powered world. Learn more now.
- [Dropbox and AugX Labs Partnership - Dropbox](https://www.dropbox.com/ventures/augx):Need a faster and easier way to create, edit, share, and store videos? Learn more about the single AI-assisted solution from AugX Labs and Dropbox.
- [Dropbox and Bardeen partnership - Dropbox](https://www.dropbox.com/ventures/bardeen):Save time and automate repetitive tasks with Bardeen and Dropbox AI automations right from your browser. Learn more about this partnership.

- [Dropbox and JustPaid Partnership - Dropbox](https://www.dropbox.com/ventures/justpaid):Dropbox and JustPaid have partnered to let you store securely, sign digitally, and automate invoicing and payments—all in one seamless workflow.
- [Dropbox and Lightbeam.ai Partnership - Dropbox](https://www.dropbox.com/ventures/lightbeam):LightBeam.ai and Dropbox help companies use AI to tackle the concerns and complexities of data privacy, compliance, and classification.
- [VPN Alternative for File Sharing](https://www.dropbox.com/vpn):Why use a VPN? Dropbox lets you share files securely inside and outside your company without wasting time on slow, complicated VPN setups. See more!

## Dropbox Dash

- [AI-powered universal search for professional services companies | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/solutions/professional-services):Dropbox Dash helps companies in the professional services industry easily find, organize, share, and secure their content.
- [AI-powered universal search for technology companies | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/solutions/technology):Dropbox Dash helps tech companies find, organize, share, and secure everything from development processes to customer research.
- [Try a demo | Explore Dash for Business](https://dash.dropbox.com/try-demo):Try Dropbox Dash today - the AI-powered tool that lets you securely find, organize, and share content from all your company's apps, files, and browser tabs.

## Dropbox Dash Features
- [What Is Dropbox Dash? - Features Overview | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/features):Dropbox Dash helps teams find, organize, and protect knowledge with search, smart organization, and secure access. Explore key features.
- [Manage everyone from one admin console | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/features/admin-console):Dropbox Dash offers a centralized console for admins to manage users, monitor usage, and control access across content from all connected apps.

- [Secure sensitive company content | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/features/protect-and-control):Protect sensitive company information while also enabling seamless collaboration. Dash provides advanced data access governance capabilities across platforms.
- [Organize, share, and collaborate—effortlessly with stacks | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/features/stacks):Stacks let your team group all types of content—files, apps, browser links, and more—and share them instantly, inside or outside your organization.
- [Personalized start pages help teams manage work and stay connected | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/features/start-page):Dash helps teams manage work, stay connected, and view meetings—all from one central dashboard.
- [Access Dash anywhere, anytime | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/features/surfaces):Dropbox Dash is available on desktop, web and mobile. Your team can access files, docs, and stacks with ease from any device — at their desk or on the go.
- [Universal search for work content | Dropbox Dash](https://dash.dropbox.com/features/universal-search):Instantly find what you’re looking for within and beyond Dropbox. Search across all your company connected apps effortlessly.
